leadText:
Pokémon: Heritage Collection II is a Region 4 DVD set released by in Australia and New Zealand on November 11, 2015. It contains 40 discs with 331 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE6368. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning.

It contains all of the episodes from seasons 10 to 16 of .

The discs are contained in a large hand-painted Great Ball mould. The discs are separated by season, with each of the seven seasons in its own foldable pocket. The disc designs match those of the season sets.
